'''Defel''' was the official language of [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]], used by the native [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

Defels were not fond of languages other than their own and most did not learn [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] unless they had need for it, mainly because they needed to leave Af'El. Ironically, more often than not, it was easy to find a Basic-speaking Defel (besides of the non-easy task to find a Defel at all). Defel language was within the grasp of most beings in the galaxy that chose to learn it.<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
